title: Archimedes Tech SPAC Partners II Co. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-20
summary: Archimedes Tech SPAC Partners II Co. (ATII), a Cayman Islands SPAC listed on Nasdaq, entered into a Merger Agreement on April 20, 2026 with Forge Nano, Inc., a Delaware corporation. The transaction involves a reincorporation to Delaware, followed by a merger structure where ATII will become Forge Nano Holdings Inc. and Forge Nano will become a wholly-owned subsidiary. Units will separate into ordinary shares and warrants exercisable at $11.50 per share.
key_points: ATII will re-domicile from Cayman Islands to Delaware and rename as Forge Nano Holdings Inc.
Forge Nano, Inc. (target company) is a Delaware corporation specializing in nano-coating technology per company name
ATII units will separate into one ordinary share and one-half warrant per unit
Warrants are exercisable at $11.50 per share for one ordinary share
Nasdaq ticker symbols: ATIIU (units), ATII (ordinary shares), ATIIW (warrants)
The transaction is structured as a multi-step process involving reincorporation, then two merger subsidiaries
